name: footer-desk
title: Footer Desk
description: A front-desk footer: one inverted tile with a contact person, a way to reach them and office clocks that tick on the minute.

props.name: heading
props.description: The display line of the section (the h2): "Talk to a person."

props.name: description
props.description: One quiet sentence under the heading.

props.name: contact
props.type: { name: string; role: string; initials?: string; avatar?: ReactNode }

props.name: email
props.description: The address that gets the copy button.

props.name: bookCall
props.type: { label: string; href: string; external?: boolean }
props.description: "Book a call". Left out, the link is left out.

props.name: offices
props.description: The offices whose local time is shown, in the order given.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment to show. Left out, the clocks read the real time after mount and tick once a minute.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the times. Default: the visitor's.

props.name: legal
props.description: A quiet line under the tile: ©, legal links.

props.name: labels
props.type: { offices?: string; sameTime?: string; pending?: string; copy?: string; copied?: string; copyFailed?: string; newTab?: string }

a11y.text: A footer with an h2 and an h3 (default "Local time") for the offices list, where each office has a time element. The email is a mailto link next to a copy button with the screen-reader-only text "Copy email"; the result is announced in a role="status" region. The avatar is aria-hidden unless you pass your own.
Link, copy button and the "Book a call" link are native.
The "Book a call" link does not scale on press under reduced motion (motion-reduce).
The clock ticks on the minute; a fixed now is used as given. Until the clock is read the times show "--:--".
